content.short: Joule Finance is a liquidity hub and money market on Aptos and Movement focusing on LRT composability.
content.description:
Joule Finance is a specialized decentralized money market and liquidity hub built natively for the Aptos and Movement blockchain ecosystems. The protocol focuses on enhancing the composability of Liquid Restaking Tokens (LRTs), allowing users to bridge, lend, and borrow against major assets like stETH and rETH across different networks. This approach provides users with increased capital efficiency and a wider range of yield-bearing opportunities within a single, unified interface.

The platform features an innovative "Efficiency Mode" that optimizes borrowing power when users employ highly correlated assets as collateral. By leveraging the high throughput and security of Move-based blockchains, Joule Finance provides a professional-grade environment for decentralized asset management. Through its focus on institutional-grade risk parameters and seamless interoperability, Joule Finance is an essential pillar for the growth of the LRT and lending landscape in the modern Web3 era.
content.meta: Joule Finance provides decentralized lending and LRT liquidity hubs for the Aptos and Movement networks.
